card.name: Endings inside Latin and German words
card.fires_on: Word endings such as -is, -ischen, -licher or -ri partway through Latin, German or Latinate names and titles. Seen mostly in citations, scholarly references and Latin phrases.

modes.label: Latin case endings
modes.description: Ending like -is or -ri inside a Latin title, phrase or term.

modes.label: German word endings
modes.description: Adjective ending inside a long German title in a reference list.
